components.name: Search result row

Snippet.default: Short supporting text that explains why this result matches.

components.description: Search result row — one line in Search suggestions. React: <SearchResultRow type state dir />. Type: Query (suggested query, matched part in text/primary, rest text/secondary), Recent (past search), Item, Person (Avatar), File. Fill query ↖ puts the text back into the field. Selected = keyboard focus in the list (accent/soft, shows ↵ hint). Props: Title, Meta, Snippet, Source, Show meta/snip

components.name: Search suggestions
components.description: Search suggestions — the panel that opens under Search field. React: <SearchSuggestions device content />. Web: floating surface/raised panel (Elevation/3), keyboard hints in the footer, first row Selected for keyboard focus. Mobile: full-screen surface/card with a Filled Search field and Cancel on top. Content: Recent (with Clear), Suggestions (Query rows), Results (grouped: People, Files,

accepted.reason: bg/base — faqat Search suggestions komponent set o'ramining (COMPONENT_SET 1130:3023) foni; variantlar surface/raised (Web) va surface/card (Mobile). Kodda talab qilinmaydi; Figma'da set o'ramini boshqa set'lar kabi bg/sheet ga bog'lash kerak.

Label/M Search suggestions'ning o'zida yo'q: u Mobile variantlaridagi ichki Search field instance'ining "Cancel" matni va Avatar bosh harflaridan ("NN") keladi (use_figma bilan tekshirildi). Kodda ular SearchField (`field` slot) va Avatar komponentlarining o'z CSS'ida. Figma'da tuzatish shart emas — extractor shu sahifadagi instance ichini ham hisoblaydi.
